answer: Each job ships a TEE quote from the enclave that ran it. Three auditors on different hardware replay it, hash the output, and void credit when the hashes differ. Addresses are just labels; the task is the unit of trust. Faking 1000 identities costs 1000 enclave quotes and 3000 honest replays per epoch, and one bad quote zeroes the batch. Pull the panel from one vendor and a lotus farm on a flat dune sends back only its own echo.
